title: Ensure no hardcoded credentials in website template
description: Audit all files in the website PHP template to confirm no hardcoded database credentials or API keys. config/database.php must use getenv() for all credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: config/database.php uses getenv() for all credentials
No hardcoded passwords in any template file
grep for password patterns returns no literal values
No hardcoded MySQL host or database names (except example defaults)

steps.details: Run: `grep -r -i 'password' src/templates/website/` and check that all results use getenv() or are placeholder strings.
Open src/templates/website/config/database.php and confirm every credential (DB_PASS, DB_USER, DB_HOST, DB_NAME) comes from getenv() calls.
Replace any hardcoded credentials with getenv() calls. Remove any debug or test credentials that may have been added.
